summary: A filter Toolbar: a search TextField, a Select, a compact NumberField without steppers, a spacer and an Export button, all in one wrapping row.
use: A filter bar above a list or table where the fields have their own widths instead of stretching to the row.
spec: `<Toolbar aria-label="Filter deals">` holding every control, no wrapper div per field
`TextField` with `hideLabel` and `width="14rem"`, then a `Select` with `hideLabel` and `width="10rem"` whose third option is long enough to be truncated
`<span class="ca-toolbar-spacer">` pushes an outlined neutral `Export` button to the end
